display_title: I Can't Help It... With a Nerd
description:
“Damn it. This is unsalvageable.” An oversized plaid shirt, eyes hidden behind long hair. A guy everyone calls a “fermentation man” because he looks like he’d smell— the only male student in Early Childhood Education… and my classmate. I didn’t hate him, but I also never wanted to get involved with him… so why the hell am I doing this with him?! “Today, I’ll wash you clean myself.” I had no choice… and ended up doing it with the loser?!

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13311375)
